# SuperMessage

> A Matrix client where agent turns, permission requests and approval gates arrive as cards in the room.

SuperMessage is in development. It is a client and keeps no store of its own: you sign in to any Matrix homeserver with a password. Agents running under AgentPod post turns and permission requests, and SuperPipeline posts approval gates; each renders as a card next to what everyone else said. The public builds are unsigned desktop previews for macOS, Windows and Linux, and debug-signed Android APKs for sideloading; iOS is TestFlight by invitation only.

- [Encryption](https://docs.supermessage.dev/use/encryption/): what is and is not end-to-end encrypted
- [Documentation home](https://docs.supermessage.dev)
